fields.comment: Thanks for posting the meeting minutes, this clears up my question about the budget line.
Jeff Sessions is another one of those Orwellian choices, he has believed the exact opposite of what the job requires his whole career.
Anyone who votes that way is a brain-dead moron and should not be allowed near a ballot.

fields.review: I got 'new' tires from them and within two weeks got a flat. The local mechanic showed me they had sold me retreads. Do not go here.
Food was genuinely good and the patio is lovely. Service took forty minutes for a salad though, and nobody checked on us once.
Eight years of coming here and they have never once gotten an order wrong. The owner remembers my kids' names. Go.
Perfectly fine. It is a sandwich shop. The sandwich was a sandwich.

fields.sentence: no movement , no yuks , not much of anything .
so relentlessly wholesome it made me want to swipe something .
a gob of drivel so sickly sweet , even the eager consumers of it will gag .
